policy.name: student-template-q24-native-v1-normal
policy.description: Native Q24 source-template Flag/Bomb inference with explicit public-origin history and count fallback.
policy.model: 80% equally weighted eight fixed source formations plus20% uniform legal armies; hard public rank and movement constraints only. Equal surviving template weights plus Q24 uniform-background evidence. Globally constrained Q12 Flag/Bomb quantization; conditional hidden mobile ranks remain exchangeable under public counts. Signed final gain truncation. Normal Classic only; absent/invalid origin history and loaded/custom positions explicitly fall back to native expectations. Distinct numerical policy from float Python bridge; no action likelihood or rollout. Research target version uses inference bank25 and an explicit experimental runtime-helper relocation recipe.
policy.information_model: Own army, public source population prior and public moves/reveals/captures only; no actual enemy army, private setup seed or private rank.
